# POP3 filter-move CopyMessages startup was not a final success boundary

Entry 2048 replaces direct/coalesced moves with CopyMessages(isMove=true, listener=null, allowUndo=false) and sets m_msgMovedByFilter when startup succeeds. Its own TODO notes that the asynchronous move can still fail and the parser cannot handle that completion. It also removes per-message coalescer/count-state transfer and end-of-download bookkeeping. Entry 2050 restores all three changed file blobs exactly and names test_quarantineFilterMove.js as failing. Current source retains coalesced moves for IMAP/pending-copy cases and direct incorporation moves otherwise. Treat the copy-service rewrite as backed-out history; a returned success code is not proof the asynchronous move completed. The named test failure was not reproduced and its causal diagnostic is unknown. Static source and test inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending-single-browser-reader.

Scope: POP3 filter move asynchronous completion and backout.
